name: Qaza'h
source:
"...You have the right to take this country."

The person who saved the protagonist and told him of his royal blood. Wears a mask and cloak, but is a woman underneath. Gave the protagonist the Egg of Marseer, and urged him to make a choice.

[spoiler]Illegitimate daughter of Burkan, the currect King of Crusch.[/spoiler]
